items.source_en:
You can find Gameplay Options in the Settings menu. These options allow you to tailor the game to suit your unique playstyle, change combat difficulty, enable survival mechanics like Sustenance, and much more!


COMBAT & SHIP DAMAGE
These four Gameplay Options affect your damage and that of all enemies you encounter:

 - Player Combat Damage

 - Enemy Combat Damage

 - Player Ship Damage

 - Enemy Ship Damage

Player options modify the damage you deal while Enemy options modify the damage dealt by enemies. Ship damage refers to damage dealt while dogfighting in space, and combat damage applies to everything else. Together, these settings scale the lethality of different modes of combat.

See also: "Melee Combat," "Mods," "Ranged Combat," "Ship Combat," and "Weapons."


AMMO WEIGHT
This option gives ammo items weight when the "Weighted Ammo" setting is selected.

See also: "Mass."


CARRY CAPACITY
The settings of the Carry Capacity option allow you to reduce, increase, or greatly increase how much you and your followers can carry.  

See also: "Mass."


CARGO ACCESS DISTANCE
This option lets you adjust the distance at which you can access your ship's cargo in your inventory menu.

See also: "Containers."


VENDOR CREDITS
The Vendor Credits option can be used to reduce or greatly increase how many credits vendors have to purchase items from you. You may need to wait a few days for vendors to refresh their stock after changing this option's settings.

See also: "Bartering," "Skills," and "Vendors."


MEDICAL ITEM HEALING
This option lets you set how Stimpaks, Trauma Packs, and Emergency Kits restore health. The "More" setting increases the total amount healed by these medical items. With the "Slowly" setting enabled, medical items heal their standard amount but at a slower rate. 

See also: "Healing."


FOOD HEALING
Food Healing settings can increase or remove healing from food items. Food that has non-healing benefits will still grant those effects, even if you set this option to "None." With the "More" setting selected, all food heals significantly more, with crafted and higher-quality food restoring even more health than simpler food like snacks or fruit.

See also: "Food."


SLEEP HEALING
The Sleep Healing option lets you set whether sleeping restores health or cures Afflictions. The "Full Restore" setting lets you restore health and cure all Afflictions when sleeping in any location. With the "Location Limited" setting selected, sleeping only restores health and only while in ships, outposts, or settlements. Sleeping does not restore health with the "None" setting selected.

SUSTENANCE
This Gameplay Option allows you to gain Sustenance Effects from food and drink items. With the "Positive Only" setting selected, using food or drink items will grant temporary positive effects like "Fed" or "Hydrated." With the "Positive & Negative" setting selected, you will gain negative effects like "Malnourished" or "Dehydrated" when you do not have a positive food or drink effect. See also: "Food" and "Watch."

The Combat Affliction Gain option controls how Afflictions are gained from combat. The "Off" setting prevents you from gaining Afflictions from combat damage. The "Improve Only" setting of the Affliction Treatment option limits the success of Treatments to only improve the Prognosis of an Affliction up to "Excellent." You must visit a Doctor or cure naturally from an "Excellent" Prognosis to remove an Affliction.

The "Advanced" setting allows your Afflictions to worsen in severity over time or give you additional Afflictions in the form of infections. See also: "Afflictions."


ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE & AFFLICTIONS
This option sets whether you gain Environmental Damage and Afflictions from hazards, weather, or ambiently while on extreme planets. Exposure to these elements will first damage your suit protection before inflicting Environmental Damage and giving you a chance to gain Afflictions. Some weather can be avoided by standing under cover whereas ambient planetary conditions, like extreme cold, can only be avoided by entering airlocked locales like starships or sealed habs.

See also: "Afflictions," "Environmental Damage," "Equipment," and "Data Menu - Starmap."


ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE RESTORATION
Each Environmental Damage Restoration setting defines special requirements for clearing your Environmental Damage. The "Resting" setting requires that you sleep or wait in a safe location that is both breathable and unexposed to environmental damage. The "Limited Resting" setting adds the requirement that this safe location is a ship, outpost, or settlement.

See also: "Environmental Damage" and "Waiting and Sleeping."


AIM ASSISTANCE
Aim Assistance can improve or challenge your combat ability depending on the selected setting. Increasing Aim Assistance helps bring your reticle to the nearest hostile enemy.

Note: This setting only applies to controller use.

See also: "Aiming."

전투 및 함선 피해
다음 네 가지 게임플레이 옵션은 플레이어와 모든 적이 입히는 피해에 영향을 줍니다:

 - 플레이어 전투 피해

 - 적 전투 피해

 - 플레이어 함선 피해

 - 적 함선 피해

플레이어 옵션은 플레이어가 입히는 피해를, 적 옵션은 적이 입히는 피해를 수정합니다. 함선 피해는 우주에서 함선 간 전투를 벌일 때 입히는 피해를 의미하며, 전투 피해는 그 외 모든 상황에 적용됩니다. 이 설정들을 조합하여 다양한 전투 모드의 치명도를 조절할 수 있습니다.

참고: "근접 전투", "모드", "원거리 전투", "함선 전투", "무기" 항목을 참조하십시오.


탄약 무게
이 옵션은 "탄약 무게 적용" 설정이 선택되었을 때 탄약 아이템에 무게를 부여합니다.

참고: "질량" 항목을 참조하십시오.


소지 중량
소지 중량 옵션 설정을 통해 플레이어와 동료가 소지할 수 있는 무게를 줄이거나, 늘리거나, 대폭 늘릴 수 있습니다.

참고: "질량" 항목을 참조하십시오.


화물 접근 거리
이 옵션은 인벤토리 메뉴에서 함선 화물에 접근할 수 있는 거리를 조정합니다.

참고: "보관함" 항목을 참조하십시오.


상점 크레딧
상점 크레딧 옵션을 사용하여 상점이 플레이어의 아이템을 구매할 때 보유하는 크레딧 양을 줄이거나 대폭 늘릴 수 있습니다. 이 옵션 설정을 변경한 후에는 상점의 재고가 갱신될 때까지 며칠을 기다려야 할 수도 있습니다.

참고: "물물교환", "스킬", "상점" 항목을 참조하십시오.


의료 아이템 회복
이 옵션은 스팀팩, 트라우마 팩, 응급 처치 키트가 체력을 회복시키는 방식을 설정합니다. "많이" 설정은 이러한 의료 아이템으로 회복되는 총량을 증가시킵니다. "천천히" 설정을 활성화하면 의료 아이템이 표준 회복량만큼 회복시키되, 더 느린 속도로 적용됩니다.

참고: "회복" 항목을 참조하십시오.


음식 회복
음식 회복 설정을 통해 음식 아이템의 회복량을 늘리거나 제거할 수 있습니다. 회복 외의 이점이 있는 음식은 이 옵션을 "없음"으로 설정하더라도 해당 효과를 계속 제공합니다. "많이" 설정을 선택하면 모든 음식이 훨씬 더 많은 체력을 회복시키며, 제작하거나 품질이 높은 음식은 간식이나 과일 같은 단순한 음식보다 더 많은 체력을 회복시킵니다.

참고: "음식" 항목을 참조하십시오.


수면 회복
수면 회복 옵션을 통해 수면 시 체력이 회복되거나 질병이 치료되는지 설정할 수 있습니다. "완전 회복" 설정은 어느 장소에서든 잠을 자면 체력을 회복하고 모든 질병을 치료합니다. "장소 제한" 설정을 선택하면 함선, 전초기지, 정착지에서 잠을 잘 때만 체력이 회복됩니다. "없음" 설정을 선택하면 수면 시 체력이 회복되지 않습니다.

참고: "대기 및 수면", "질병" 항목을 참조하십시오.


영양 섭취
이 게임플레이 옵션을 통해 음식과 음료 아이템에서 영양 섭취 효과를 얻을 수 있습니다. "긍정적 효과만" 설정을 선택하면 음식이나 음료 아이템을 사용할 때 "포만감"이나 "수분 보충" 같은 일시적인 긍정적 효과를 얻습니다. "긍정적 및 부정적 효과" 설정을 선택하면 음식이나 음료의 긍정적 효과가 없을 때 "영양실조"나 "탈수" 같은 부정적 효과를 얻게 됩니다. 활성화된 영양 섭취 효과는 "상태 효과" 목록에 표시되며 시계의 알림으로도 확인할 수 있습니다.

참고: "음식", "시계" 항목을 참조하십시오.


전투 질병 발생
전투 질병 발생 옵션은 전투를 통해 질병에 걸리는 방식을 제어합니다. "꺼짐" 설정은 전투 피해로 질병에 걸리는 것을 방지합니다. "증가" 설정은 생명체로부터 질병에 걸릴 확률을 높이며, 포탑, 드로이드, 인간 전투원으로부터 "자상"과 같은 질병에 걸릴 확률을 추가합니다.

참고: 환경 피해 및 질병 게임플레이 옵션 설정에 따라 위험 요소, 날씨, 또는 극한 행성에서의 환경적 요인으로 질병에 걸릴 수 있습니다.

참고: "질병" 항목을 참조하십시오.


질병 치료
질병 치료 옵션의 "개선만" 설정은 치료 성공 범위를 질병의 예후를 "우수" 단계까지만 개선하는 것으로 제한합니다. 질병을 완전히 제거하려면 의사를 방문하거나 "우수" 예후 상태에서 자연 치유가 되어야 합니다.

참고: "질병", "의사" 항목을 참조하십시오.


질병 예후
"고급" 설정은 질병이 시간이 지남에 따라 악화되거나 감염 형태로 추가 질병을 유발하도록 합니다. 예를 들어, "골절" 질병이 "급성"으로 악화되거나 "뼈 감염" 질병을 유발할 수 있습니다. 또한 "고급" 설정은 질병에서 자연적으로 회복될 확률을 눈에 띄게 높여줍니다.

참고: "질병" 항목을 참조하십시오.


환경 피해 및 질병
이 옵션은 위험 요소, 날씨, 또는 극한 행성에서의 환경적 요인으로 환경 피해와 질병을 얻게 될지 설정합니다. 이러한 요소에 노출되면 먼저 슈트 보호막이 손상된 후 환경 피해를 입고 질병에 걸릴 확률이 생깁니다. 일부 날씨는 엄폐물 아래에 서서 피할 수 있지만, 극한의 추위와 같은 행성 환경 조건은 함선이나 밀폐된 거주 구역 같은 기밀 장소로 들어가야만 피할 수 있습니다.

참고: "질병", "환경 피해", "장비", "데이터 메뉴 - 성계 지도" 항목을 참조하십시오.


환경 피해 복구
각 환경 피해 복구 설정은 환경 피해를 제거하기 위한 특별한 요구 사항을 정의합니다. "휴식" 설정은 숨을 쉴 수 있고 환경 피해에 노출되지 않는 안전한 장소에서 잠을 자거나 대기할 것을 요구합니다. "제한적 휴식" 설정은 이 안전한 장소가 함선, 전초기지, 정착지여야 한다는 요구 사항을 추가합니다.

참고: "환경 피해", "대기 및 수면" 항목을 참조하십시오.


조준 보조
조준 보조는 선택한 설정에 따라 전투 능력을 향상시키거나 도전적인 경험을 제공합니다. 조준 보조를 높이면 조준점이 가장 가까운 적에게 더 잘 고정됩니다.

참고: 이 설정은 컨트롤러 사용 시에만 적용됩니다.

참고: "조준" 항목을 참조하십시오.

You can find Gameplay Options in the Settings menu. These options allow you to tailor the game to suit your unique playstyle, change combat difficulty, enable survival mechanics like Sustenance, and much more!


COMBAT & SHIP DAMAGE
These four Gameplay Options affect your damage and that of all enemies you encounter:

 - Player Combat Damage

 - Enemy Combat Damage

 - Player Ship Damage

 - Enemy Ship Damage

Player options modify the damage you deal while Enemy options modify the damage dealt by enemies. Ship damage refers to damage dealt while dogfighting in space, and combat damage applies to everything else. Together, these settings scale the lethality of different modes of combat.

See also: "Melee Combat," "Mods," "Ranged Combat," "Ship Combat," and "Weapons."


AMMO WEIGHT
This option gives ammo items weight when the "Weighted Ammo" setting is selected.

See also: "Mass."


CARRY CAPACITY
The settings of the Carry Capacity option allow you to reduce, increase, or greatly increase how much you and your followers can carry.  

See also: "Mass."


CARGO ACCESS DISTANCE
This option lets you adjust the distance at which you can access your ship's cargo in your inventory menu.

See also: "Containers."


VENDOR CREDITS
The Vendor Credits option can be used to reduce or greatly increase how many credits vendors have to purchase items from you. You may need to wait a few days for vendors to refresh their stock after changing this option's settings.

See also: "Bartering," "Skills," and "Vendors."


MEDICAL ITEM HEALING
This option lets you set how Med Packs, Trauma Packs, and Emergency Kits restore health. The "More" setting increases the total amount healed by these medical items. With the "Slowly" setting enabled, medical items heal their standard amount but at a slower rate. 

See also: "Healing."


FOOD HEALING
Food Healing settings can increase or remove healing from food items. Food that has non-healing benefits will still grant those effects, even if you set this option to "None." With the "More" setting selected, all food heals significantly more, with crafted and higher-quality food restoring even more health than simpler food like snacks or fruit.

See also: "Food."


SLEEP HEALING
The Sleep Healing option lets you set whether sleeping restores health or cures Afflictions. The "Full Restore" setting lets you restore health and cure all Afflictions when sleeping in any location. With the "Location Limited" setting selected, sleeping only restores health and only while in ships, outposts, or settlements. Sleeping does not restore health with the "None" setting selected.

See also: "Waiting and Sleeping" and "Afflictions."


SUSTENANCE
This Gameplay Option allows you to gain Sustenance Effects from food and drink items. With the "Positive Only" setting selected, using food or drink items will grant temporary positive effects like "Fed" or "Hydrated." With the "Positive & Negative" setting selected, you will gain negative effects like "Malnourished" or "Dehydrated" when you do not have a positive food or drink effect. Active Sustenance Effects are listed in your "Status Effects" and displayed in reminders on your watch.

See also: "Food" and "Watch."


COMBAT AFFLICTION GAIN
The Combat Affliction Gain option controls how Afflictions are gained from combat. The "Off" setting prevents you from gaining Afflictions from combat damage. The "Increased" setting increases your chance to gain Afflictions from creatures and adds a chance to gain Afflictions like "Puncture Wounds" from turrets, robots, and human combatants.

Note: You can still gain Afflictions from hazards, weather, or ambiently while on extreme planets depending on your settings in the Environmental Damage & Afflictions Gameplay Option. 

See also: "Afflictions."


AFFLICTION TREATMENT
The "Improve Only" setting of the Affliction Treatment option limits the success of Treatments to only improve the Prognosis of an Affliction up to "Excellent." You must visit a Doctor or cure naturally from an "Excellent" Prognosis to remove an Affliction.

See also: "Afflictions" and "Doctors."


AFFLICTION PROGNOSIS
The "Advanced" setting allows your Afflictions to worsen in severity over time or give you additional Afflictions in the form of infections. For example, a "Fractured Limb" Affliction could worsen to become "Acute" in severity or give you a "Bone Infection" Affliction. The "Advanced" setting also noticeably increases your chance to recover from Afflictions naturally.

See also: "Afflictions."


ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE & AFFLICTIONS
This option sets whether you gain Environmental Damage and Afflictions from hazards, weather, or ambiently while on extreme planets. Exposure to these elements will first damage your suit protection before inflicting Environmental Damage and giving you a chance to gain Afflictions. Some weather can be avoided by standing under cover whereas ambient planetary conditions, like extreme cold, can only be avoided by entering airlocked locales like starships or sealed habs.

See also: "Afflictions," "Environmental Damage," "Equipment," and "Data Menu - Starmap."


ENVIRONMENTAL DAMAGE RESTORATION
Each Environmental Damage Restoration setting defines special requirements for clearing your Environmental Damage. The "Resting" setting requires that you sleep or wait in a safe location that is both breathable and unexposed to environmental damage. The "Limited Resting" setting adds the requirement that this safe location is a ship, outpost, or settlement.

See also: "Environmental Damage" and "Waiting and Sleeping."


AIM ASSISTANCE
Aim Assistance can improve or challenge your combat ability depending on the selected setting. Increasing Aim Assistance helps bring your reticle to the nearest hostile enemy.

Note: This setting only applies to controller use.

See also: "Aiming."

items.source_en:
Log Entry ES03-0001
Morgan, Sarah, Cmdr, N78422ES

It's been two days since my crash-landing on Serenno. I've been slipping in and out of consciousness, but I've been able to use emergency meds to keep my pain levels to a minimum. Medical self-assessment has revealed three cracked ribs, a broken forearm, a minor concussion, probable internal damage and a hell of a lot of bruises. I'll do the best that I can to push through, but I can't allow my injuries to keep me from reaching Shuttle 02.

Tomorrow I plan to do a full reconnoiter of the area and search for some high ground to place my distress beacon. With any luck, some ships are still in orbit, and they'll receive my signal. For now, I'm going to rest, eat a bit of my food rations and pray that the other shuttle isn't too far from my location.
